purpose: Test whether the graph-dependent safe expert contributes certificate cover beyond parameter- and budget-matched graph-invariant expert unions.

components.feature_ce: two-layer graph-invariant feature expert trained with CE
components.feature_kd_cad: two-layer graph-invariant feature expert trained with CE, KD and zero-radius CAD
components.spectral_identity_cad: one-layer normalized-ReLU polynomial expert with P=I, zero completion radius, CE and CAD
components.spectral_cad: one-layer normalized-ReLU polynomial expert with observed P, retained-mass radius, CE and CAD

priority_within_every_union: feature_kd_cad first, comparator second, frozen FedLap+ teacher otherwise
prohibited_actions: changing models, losses, priorities, thresholds or seeds after any E24 test result
selecting a cover or route per dataset
recomputing routing after a completion is revealed
claiming exact parameter matching between the two different feature MLPs and the spectral architecture; exact matching is required and audited only for observed-P versus P=I spectral experts
